name: Road Work Ahead's Gambit
author: Minty
summary: Capturing an enemy piece crumbles the tile ahead of it.
description: A rare gambit that turns every capture into demolition work. Whenever you take an enemy piece, the tile directly ahead of it (one square north) crumbles away, as if a crumbler had been at work. Stock tiles are spared. Installs alongside the Gambit Creation API.
